structure: Part 14 of trace:e2e: lifecycle, declaration, persistence and the full promoted journey for live animals (GBN-AG), on the live-animals frontend at localhost:3000/live-animals plus direct backend calls at localhost:8085. Read in full: the 8 spec files named in the part (pages/declaration, features/cancel-amend-ui, features/amend-resubmit, features/promoted-lifecycle, journeys/promoted-notification, journeys/persistence/api-seed-parity, persistence-accompanying-document, persistence-notification), and all 14 trace zips, each unpacked in the part14 working folder and mined from its own trace, network and resource files: decl (declaration renders the page controls), declerr (declaration error summary), clink (Cancel amendment link while amending), cconfirm (cancel-amend confirmation page), cno (No keeps the amendment), cyes (Yes restores the submitted answers), amend (Submitted to Amending to Submitted with the edited answer kept), lifeapi (API-only lifecycle: create, fulfilments read, submit, amend, cancel-amend, copy twice, soft-delete twice), lifero (submitted view read-only, then Amend from the dashboard re-enters at Overview), parity (browser-driven and seeded submissions), pdoc (accompanying document upload, virus scan, reload), pdraft (journey up to declaration), psub (full submission then read-only reload), promoted (full journey dashboard to confirmation). Pages seen, in journey order: Dashboard (/live-animals) > Origin of the import (/origin) > What are you importing? (/commodities, search then species checkbox) > Overview hub (/notifications/{ref}) > Commodity details (/consignment-details) > Identification details (/commodities/identification) > Main reason for import (/import-reason) > Additional details (/additional-details) > Consignment addresses (/addresses) with four party select pages (consignors, destinations, place-of-origin, consignees, importers /select) > Add the county parish holding number (CPH) (/cph-number) > Arrival details (/port-of-entry) > Which countries will the consignment travel through? (/transit-countries) > Transporter details (/transporters) > Contact address for consignment (/consignment/contact/select) > Review your notification (/notification-view) > Declaration (/declaration) > Import notification submitted (/confirmation). Conditional pages: Upload documents (/accompanying-documents, only pdoc walks it), Cancel this amendment? (/cancel-amend, only while Amending), notification-view?cancelled=1 (after Yes). The read-only Submitted view and the Amending view are the same URL as the Draft review. Several traces drive state through the browser, but the seeding fixtures (readyToSubmit, createAmendNotification, createSubmittedNotification) also go through the frontend's own form POSTs without a concurrency token, which shows the linear Save and continue order. The Mongo reads in the persistence specs leave no trace: the stored-document shapes are taken from the spec assertions, which passed, and are marked as such.
